item.text: I’ll split slot validation and persistence from double-booking prevention, update the dependencies and coverage map, and send the revised plan for independent review.

Review id: R2
Independently review this complete revised Storybloq setup plan. Return schema-shaped verdict and findings for requirements coverage, usable journeys, ticket boundaries/dependencies, concurrency/data safety, feasibility and acceptance evidence. Do not write files or execute tests/install/build/server. This is the second review round. R1 returned approve_with_findings and clarified that a rolling 168-hour window can span eight calendar dates; incorporated below.
Owner adjustment: \"Split the booking ticket so that preventing double bookings is its own ticket.\" D is now slot validation/persistence, J is dedicated double-booking prevention; E now depends on J. Other scope is unchanged.
Sources: README.md says tennis club three courts, member books one-hour slot, court cannot be booked twice for same slot, cancel until two hours before start, guest payments later. Owner: approximately 80 members, individual club accounts, up to seven days ahead, max two upcoming bookings, retain Django, other questions delegated to judgment.
Observed baseline: Django Booking model with court PositiveSmallIntegerField, starts_at DateTimeField, member CharField and UniqueConstraint(court,starts_at). Django auth/contenttypes installed, SQLite, USE_TZ true; no migrations, URL/views/templates/cancellation. requirements has Django/pytest/pytest-django, Makefile test target runs pytest, README command make test, pytest.ini collects tests.py and test_*.py with club.settings; bookings/tests.py exists. No git. Baseline code not claimed as complete behavior; no completed tickets proposed.
Project Court bookings; generic type, Python/Django. Defaults: staff-provisioned accounts/admin password reset, server-rendered forms, configurable club timezone initially UTC; courts 1..3, local clock-hour starts exactly one elapsed hour; start>now and start<=now+168h; active future starts count toward quota. Cancel allowed at exactly two hours remaining, denied below; own bookings only, preserve canceled records, reuse canceled slots. Display all eligible starts even across eight calendar dates, include explicit offset handling for DST ambiguity and reject nonexistent hours. No opening-hour restriction. SQLite retained with supported serialized write strategy, real concurrency tests; no reliance on ineffective row locks.
Milestones after existing/default p0: p1 Accounts and preview, p2 Safe booking, p3 Member experience and acceptance. Temporary labels A-J, with J ordered between D and E.

A p1 Individual accounts and runnable Django foundation.
Outcome: each member signs in with own club account (owner).
Scope: Django URL/settings/templates, login/logout, admin-only account provisioning/password reset, migrations and authenticated Booking ownership with explicit safe legacy member mapping. Excludes: public signup.
Acceptance: two accounts work independently, anonymous requests redirect, server resolves member identity, CSRF protects mutations, clean migration works; existing text-member rows require explicit mapping and unresolved rows block rather than invent ownership.
Behaviour: accessible labels, generic failed-login errors, safe logout, authorization failures, preserve data.
Verification: make test for login/access/migrations/legacy mapping and rollback; local setup docs. Prerequisites: none. Assumptions: staff provisions accounts, no evidence of deployed data.

B p1 Booking interaction preview.
Outcome: owner sees member booking journey before integration (README/owner).
Scope: demo availability for three courts and whole rolling window, my bookings, quota/conflict/cancellation states, timezone labels. Excludes: live booking writes.
Acceptance: keyboard-usable preview, all eligible hours through inclusive 168h upper limit even across eight dates, empty and occupied states, no other-member identities exposed.
Behaviour: accessible forms, focus/errors/status feedback, explicitly demo data.
Verification: make test template checks and owner inspection. Prerequisites: A. Assumptions: server-rendered hourly-slot site.

C p1 Checkpoint: member booking flow and timezone.
Question: Is the preview understandable and is the timezone display appropriate?
Artifact: B screens and explicit UTC/configurable timezone assumptions.
Criteria: owner inspects journey and display, changes recorded. Prerequisites: B. Only G waits on this checkpoint; backend uses configurable timezone.

D p2 Court slot validation and booking persistence.
Outcome: represent and validate eligible one-hour court bookings (README/owner).
Scope: court range, aware aligned start, configurable club timezone, future/seven-day window, active/canceled lifecycle fields and migrations, basic internal persistence service. Preserve the existing court/start uniqueness protection at this stage. Excludes: changing uniqueness to allow reuse after cancellation or implementing/verifying concurrent conflict handling (J); quota (E); cancellation action (F); live endpoint (G).
Acceptance: reject invalid court, past/unaligned/nonexistent/out-of-window starts; exactly seven days eligible if aligned; distinguish ambiguous hours; persist and retrieve valid owned booking and lifecycle state without dropping existing uniqueness.
Behaviour: actionable validation errors, atomic rollback, authenticated member identity is an explicit trusted input; internal service not exposed before safeguards.
Verification: make test for court/time boundaries, DST, persistence and migration preserving existing uniqueness. Prerequisites: A. Assumptions: all hours offered, rolling 168h window, starts aligned to local hours.

J p2 Prevent double bookings.
Outcome: a court can never have two active bookings for the same slot, including simultaneous requests (README).
Scope: database-enforced active-slot uniqueness; safe migration from existing unconditional constraint, no unprotected migration gap; atomic booking conflict handling and SQLite-supported write transaction foundation; permit reuse of a canceled slot while retaining canceled records. Excludes: per-member quota policy (E), cancellation authorization/cutoff action (F), UI (G).
Acceptance: sequential duplicate denied, concurrent independent connections targeting same court/instant yield exactly one active booking; different courts or slots remain bookable; direct persistence cannot bypass uniqueness; canceled rows do not reserve slots; failed writes rollback; canceled records survive constraint migration.
Behaviour: actionable occupied-slot result, bounded contention handling, safe retry/rollback without partial writes; no reliance on SQLite select_for_update.
Verification: make test DB-constraint and migration regressions, real concurrent-connection tests against file-backed SQLite, canceled-slot reuse fixtures; no code-only assertion of concurrency correctness. Prerequisites: D. Assumptions: SQLite retained; F later provides cancellation operation; this ticket may construct canceled records directly in tests.

E p2 Two-upcoming-booking limit.
Outcome: no member holds more than two active future bookings (owner).
Scope: enforce quota within J transaction strategy and D/J booking service, serialize same-member concurrent writes; define active future count. Excludes: UI and cancellation action.
Acceptance: third denied, past/canceled excluded, simultaneous different-slot requests for same member cannot exceed two; slot uniqueness stays intact.
Behaviour: quota/conflict errors, bounded contention retries, safe rollback.
Verification: make test quota boundaries and real independent-connection concurrency tests on SQLite. Prerequisites: J. Assumptions: no extra overlap restriction.

F p2 Own-booking cancellation.
Outcome: member cancels own booking with at least two hours remaining (README).
Scope: authorized cancellation through shared serialization; preserve records, release slot/quota. Excludes: staff policy overrides and UI.
Acceptance: exactly two hours allowed, below denied, other member denied, repeat safe, concurrent cancellation/create maintains both constraints.
Behaviour: privacy-preserving authorization failures, clear late error, aware clock.
Verification: make test cutoff/ownership/retry/reuse/concurrency regressions. Prerequisites: E. Assumptions: inclusive cutoff.

G p3 Live availability and member bookings.
Outcome: member signs in, selects court/hour, books, views own bookings and cancels (README/owner).
Scope: wire B to D/J/E/F, availability through all eligible rolling-window hours, CSRF-protected POST forms and own-bookings screen. Excludes: others' identities, deferred features.
Acceptance: complete journey, clear occupied/quota/cutoff states, stale availability cannot cause duplicates, forged requests cannot bypass rules, canceled slots become available, eight-date windows fully navigable.
Behaviour: accessible focus/errors/status, empty states, submission feedback where relevant, safe repeat submissions, timezone labels and refreshed conflicts.
Verification: make test Django client journey/security tests and keyboard walkthrough. Prerequisites: C,E,F (J/D transitively). Assumptions: no SPA.

H p3 Acceptance evidence and operating guide.
Outcome: staff can provision approximately 80 accounts and run/verify first version.
Scope: integrated acceptance matrix, staff account/timezone setup, backup/restore smoke procedure, production configuration checklist (external secrets, debug off, hosts, HTTPS/secure cookies), establish supported server/readiness command. Excludes: public deployment execution, invented load targets.
Acceptance: full auth/booking rule and failure evidence incl concurrency and eight-date navigation, clean setup and two-account demo; production settings documented before real use.
Behaviour: recovery instructions for contention and legacy mapping, no secrets in docs.
Verification: make test integrated tests, documented restore and keyboard walkthrough during implementation, never setup. Prerequisites: G. Assumptions: hosting undecided, local first version.

I p3 Checkpoint: first-version acceptance.
Criteria: owner demonstrates account login, three courts/hour slots, inclusive seven-day window, max two upcoming, no duplicate under races, own cancellation at cutoff and rejection below cutoff, privacy and agreed timezone.
Artifact: running app and H evidence. Prerequisites: H.
Checkpoints are ordinary tickets/dependencies, not enforced owner-approval gates.

Coverage: individual accounts/80 members=A,H; court/hour/time bounds=D,G,H; double-booking prevention=J,G,H; max two=E,G,H; cancel=F,G,H; Django=A..H/J; delegated identity/UI/timezone/privacy/migration=A,B,C,D,J,F,G,H; acceptance=I; guest payments deferred explicitly. No complete tickets; existing model is baseline evidence only.
Package creates default p0 plus three milestones, ten tickets with above descriptions and dependency wiring, Storybloq config, baseline snapshot, setup note/initial handover recording sources/coverage/assumptions/review/quality/checkpoint limitation.
Governance: new AGENTS.md purpose/stack/architecture/scope/assumptions/testing; RULES.md business invariants/security/TDD for business logic; REVIEW.md verbatim installed review-contract-template.md. Existing governance files would never be overwritten. Git init and .gitignore for .story/snapshots/, .story/sessions/, .story/status.json, Python caches, .venv, local SQLite and secret env files. No GitHub import.
Quality level: Full pipeline because workflow/business rules. WRITE_TESTS enabled command make test; TEST enabled make test. Established from explicit README/Makefile command plus collected test source, not execution. BUILD disabled no established build command. VERIFY disabled/pending routes/readiness, proposed python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000 and http://127.0.0.1:8000/accounts/login/. Never run install/test/build/dev server in setup. App implementation outside setup.
Excluded first-version: guest payments, public signup, notifications, recurring bookings, public deployment execution. Hosting unresolved but does not block local version.
Nothing written until explicit approval of this revised package.

STORYBLOQ_PLAN"

item.text:
The revised plan gives **double-booking prevention its own ticket, J**. Ticket D now covers slot validation and persistence; the two-booking quota ticket E depends on J.

J will verify that simultaneous requests cannot create two active bookings for the same court and time, that conflicts return useful errors, and that canceled slots can be booked again without deleting their history. D preserves the existing uniqueness constraint until J safely updates it.

The package now contains **10 tickets across three milestones**, plus Storybloq’s default setup phase:

| Milestone | Ticket | Depends on |
|---|---|---|
| Accounts and preview | **A:** Individual accounts and Django foundation | — |
| | **B:** Accessible booking-flow preview | A |
| | **C:** Checkpoint: inspect member journey and timezone display | B |
| Safe booking | **D:** Court slot validation and booking persistence | A |
| | **J:** Prevent double bookings | D |
| | **E:** Enforce two upcoming bookings per member | J |
| | **F:** Own-booking cancellation and cutoff enforcement | E |
| Member experience | **G:** Live availability, booking, and cancellation screens | C, E, F |
| | **H:** Acceptance evidence and staff operating guide | G |
| | **I:** Checkpoint: first-version acceptance | H |

Coverage now maps court/hour validation and the seven-day window to **D**, and double-booking prevention to **J**. Integrated verification remains in G/H. A can start immediately after setup.

The first version remains a Django website for individual member accounts, three courts, hourly bookings, a rolling seven-day window, and cancellation with at least two hours remaining. Assumptions remain staff-created accounts and a configurable timezone initially set to UTC. Guest payments and public deployment execution remain deferred. Checkpoints are ordinary dependency tickets, not enforced owner-approval gates.

Approval covers initializing **Court bookings** as a Python/Django project; creating the phases, tickets, dependencies, snapshot, setup note, and handover; writing `AGENTS.md`, `RULES.md`, and `REVIEW.md`; and initializing Git with appropriate ignore entries. File previews remain available.

Quality level: Full pipeline, because booking rules and concurrent requests need verification.

| Stage | Command | Status |
|---|---|---|
| WRITE_TESTS | `make test` | Established; enabled |
| TEST | `make test` | Established; enabled |
| BUILD | None | Disabled |
| VERIFY | `python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000` | Pending runnable routes/readiness; disabled |

No setup files have been written.

Independent review: approve, invocation R2
